name: OpenAI public web quality benchmark
notes: The benchmark is limited to exact allowlisted public HTTPS pages.
Results are quality and regression signals, not proof of a security vulnerability or service outage.
No sign-in, API key, prompt, conversation, file upload, payment, workspace change, tool call, or agent action is performed.
The Status page is treated as a public web surface; its incident content is contextual and is not used alone to infer root cause.
Any future authenticated, API, adversarial, or security work requires a separate written scope and authorization.
